body: ### Features - **AI Guard:** Apply backend extra_tags and extra_metastruct to AI Guard spans [#10865](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10865) - **Feature Flags:** Add global Datadog exposure logging switch [#10954](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10954) - **LLM Observability:** Accept an agent version manually [#10536](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10536) - **LLM Observability:** Report Nova Sonic text token counts [#10821](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10821) - **LLM Observability:** Tag OpenAI decision spans with decision_provider [#10973](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10973) ### Fixes - **bundling:** Avoid crashes when dd-trace is bundled with Vite [#10971](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10971) - **General:** Preserve native headers when extending CORS responses [#10878](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10878) - **instrumentations:** Instrument loaded hooked built-ins when dd-trace is bundled [#10915](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10915) - **OpenTelemetry:** Avoid repeating global tags as OTLP span attributes [#10886](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10886) - **span-stats:** Only report hostname in client stats when DD_TRACE_REPORT_HOSTNAME is set [#10972](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10972) - **stripe:** Prevent repeated wrapping of shared webhooks [#10959](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10959) - **Test Optimization:** Disable DogStatsD metrics [#10961](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10961) - **Test Optimization:** Distinguish native retries from ATR [#10942](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10942) - **Test Optimization:** Limit PR head metadata fetches [#10887](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10887) - **Test Optimization:** Prevent lazy PR head metadata fetches [#10984](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10984) - **Test Optimization:** Tear down Jest before waiting for suite finish [#10960](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10960) - **Test Optimization / Debugger:** Don't start on Bun or Deno [#10888](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10888) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **Dependencies:** Bump @apm-js-collab/code-transformer from 0.18.1 to 0.19.0 in /vendor in the vendor-minor-and-patch-dependencies group across 1 directory [#10948](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10948) - **Dependencies:** Update import-in-the-middle to 3.5.3 [#10947](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10947) - **eslint:** Update Unicorn to v78 [#10798](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10798) - **guardrails:** Allow interleaved debug output [#10944](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10944) - **integration-tests:** Split large test optimization specs for parallel CI [#10911](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10911) - **integration-tests:** Split slow webdriverio, vitest and testopt CI jobs [#10913](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10913) - **Test Optimization:** Cover Jest agent discovery failures and recovery [#10962](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10962) - **Test Optimization:** Fix flaky retained-trace hook test [#10940](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10940) - **Test Optimization:** Skip native retry attribution on legacy Cypress [#10982](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10982) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/avara1986) [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/cgcote) [](https://github.com/datadog-bits) [](https://github.com/israelALF) [](https://github.com/juan-fernandez) [](https://github.com/khanayan123) [](https://github.com/leoromanovsky) [](https://github.com/mhlidd) [](https://github.com/mz1119) [](https://github.com/ncybul) [](https://github.com/pabloerhard) [](https://github.com/rochdev) [](https://github.com/watson) [](https://github.com/ZStriker19)
